rules_profile.mask: pair union; exclude only two established zero denominators
rules_profile.delta: after minus before; exact fractions; unavailable remains null

rules_profile.quality: independent checks; deletion and replacement do not repair old facts

daily_density.explicit_count: matching reviewed exact count exempts defaults; mismatch deducts 100
daily_density.population: source-distinct primary visit occurrences on every requested date
daily_density.mean: equal requested-date weight; exact arithmetic; empty dates included
daily_density.overall: max(0, five-dimensional auxiliary score minus mean daily penalty)
daily_density.unknown: no guessed count or pace; bounds retained; unresolved deduction is unavailable
